title: bowenliang123/dsh-context: a dashboard for what a DeepSeek agent is carrying
friendlyTitle: dsh-context shows what a DeepSeek agent is carrying
summary: dsh-context is a plugin for DeepSeek Harness that shows how a session's context is composed, how it changes, and where commands ran. It adds a context dashboard, browser, sidebar, and command, with English and Simplified Chinese. GitHub's daily TypeScript trending list had it at 321 stars today. It supports @deepseek-ai/dsh from 0.2.0-rc.2 on the 0.2.0 and 0.2.1 lines, and is Apache-2.0.
friendlySummary: dsh-context is a plugin for DeepSeek Harness. It shows how a session's context is built, how it changes, and where commands ran. It adds a context dashboard, a browser, a sidebar, and a command. The interface is in English and Simplified Chinese. GitHub's daily TypeScript trending list had it at 321 stars today. It supports @deepseek-ai/dsh from version 0.2.0-rc.2, on the 0.2.0 and 0.2.1 lines. The license is Apache-2.0.
whyItMatters: If you use DeepSeek Harness, this is a way to see which parts of the prompt are using the window before you guess why the agent forgot something. Category figures are the harness's own estimates; the token card also shows the provider's billed total. It will not help on Claude Code or Codex. The version floor is real.
